_about: Console 1 mk1 light block in Softube mode (cmd 0x01, 97 data bytes: [0]=counter, [1..96]=values). Confirmed with Softube's own frames + camera, 2026-11-18. Values 0-127; buttons: 0 off, 63 dim, 127 bright; rings: 0-127 dot position; 3-state indicators: 0/63/127 pick the LED.

layers._about: A button lights only if its level is set AND its switch in the layer positions is set. Track buttons and the Display/Page buttons use layer positions 73-75 and 84-87 (packed, one switch per button); rings, Preset and Hard Gate use the enable positions 76-82. Simplest safe default: set all layer/enable positions to 127 and drive brightness with the level positions.

meter_switches._about: Position 83: bit 6 = Shape (gate) meter on, bit 5 = Compressor meter on. Confirmed on hardware 2026-11-18.

enable_switches._about: Positions 76-82 switch individual lights fully off. Light position P (22..70) -> position 76 + (P-22)//7, bit 6 - (P-22)%7. Confirmed on hardware 2026-11-18.

track_bright._about: Track buttons: level >0 = dim; bright switch in 84 bit1 (t1), 84 bit0 (t2), 85 bits 6..0 (t3-9), 86 bits 6..0 (t10-16), 87 bits 6..3 (t17-20). Level values in between show no difference.
